episodes.topic: What Smoking Does to Your Body
How Kidney Stones Form, Crystal by Crystal
How Does a Healthy Tooth Rot?
How Does the Flu Spread From Person to Person?

lang.name: Contagion Trace Surveillance
lang.art_style: Max Flat — the channel look: flat colour backgrounds, thick dark outlines, flat fills, the signature character MAX — everything drawn in code with the channel puppet kit, no painted images
lang.shape_language: Technical and geometric: people are faceless capsule-and-circle silhouettes, lungs and airways built from smooth vector tubes, virus particles as spiked circles; rooms shown as top-down floorplan wireframes with hotspot rings marking infection zones.
lang.line_quality: Thin, precise, uniform technical strokes that trace on like plotted paths, with dashed connector lines linking infected to exposed people and small reticle brackets around subjects.
lang.texture: Faint drifting scan-grid, subtle CRT flicker and fine noise over deep charcoal; soft green glow bloom on highlighted elements.
lang.motion_personality: Mechanical and eased: outlines draw on, hotspot dots ripple outward in concentric pulses, counters tick up with ease-out, data labels type on, and scenes change with scan-line wipes.
lang.camera: Slow push-ins and parallax drift over layered top-down maps and room plans, occasional split-screen comparing transmission routes (cough, touch, air), and tracking-shot zooms from a room down to a single droplet.
lang.typography_feel: Wide-tracked all-caps monospaced labels typed on like telemetry, paired with large condensed numerals for statistics that count up, with one key word per caption underlined in amber.

short_lang.name: Soft Sneeze Storybook
short_lang.art_style: Max Flat — the channel look: flat colour backgrounds, thick dark outlines, flat fills, the signature character MAX — everything drawn in code with the channel puppet kit, no painted images
short_lang.shape_language: Blobby and rounded: people are pill-bodied characters with dot eyes, droplets are plump teardrops, virus particles are soft scalloped circles, lungs and rooms are built from pillowy rounded rectangles and circles.
short_lang.line_quality: Mostly no outlines; occasional soft rounded-cap strokes in navy for arrows, motion puffs and dotted droplet trails showing the path from sneezer to neighbor.
short_lang.texture: Light riso paper grain, subtle halftone dots in shadows, slight ink misregistration on colour layers, and a pale dotted background pattern.
short_lang.motion_personality: Bouncy and friendly: characters squash and stretch, droplets pop out with overshoot and drift in lazy arcs, shapes morph between scenes, idle breathing and blinking loops keep everything alive.
short_lang.camera: Mostly flat front-on 2D vertical framing with gentle parallax between foreground and background layers, quick punch-in zooms on key moments like a sneeze or a handshake, and simple split panels comparing cough, touch and shared air.
short_lang.typography_feel: Large rounded Poppins semibold sentence-case captions in navy, a few words per beat, key word highlighted in a coral blob behind it, bouncing in with light overshoot.
